capabilities: Native fiber upper bounds and portable card counts are not one-to-one density or coverage measures; a card can depict multiple fibers.
Normal detail changes lighting, not strands or silhouette. An absent undercoat does not mean absent normal maps or a flat surface.
Export headroom is a conservative arithmetic allowance, not proof of UV eligibility, material compatibility or visual quality; capacity and UV admission require a probe.

export_capacity.scope: Unused conservative allowance after base, card corners and reserved vertices; not measured export size or admission

native_groom.count_scope: Configured upper bound, not independently counted visible fibers

normal_detail.scope: Authored settings and measured finished-model routes; original source settings are not reconstructed

portable_geometry.count_scope: Reported geometry cards, not counted fibers or measured coverage

scope: Facts about this saved recipe only, not a current quality verdict or a prescribed repair.

undercoat.scope: Optional lighting detail; absence does not establish a flat surface or absent source normals
